rv.q: I loved absolutely everything but the play itself, which would definitely have benefited from judicious editing.
Rice stages this with several minor set changes adding length without depth to the experience.

Yasko’s performance is by far the most solid in the show, whether she’s fulminating against the elites who abused Bosola’s loyalty (or greed) or handling sword and dagger in the final thrilling fight (designed by Maya Vinice Prentiss).
This plays into the fact that the play itself in its entirety is excellently done.

cn.t: Babes with Blades Theatre Company delivers another strong production, praised for its excellent stage combat and commitment to elevating underrepresented voices through Webster's dark Jacobean revenge tragedy.
